snippet.title: Puyo Puyo~n: Car-kun to Issho (PlayStation) - Scenario Mode Normal - 1,123,935 pts.
snippet.description: This version's like the Dreamcast version, but many graphics are downscaled like the Nintendo 64 version. It's the only home console port to lack a 4-player mode, but also introduces a mode called "Curry Story". You're battling a seemingly endless amount of enemies, and completing it unlocks the PocketStation minigame "Together with Car-kun", where you can take care of Carbuncle like a virtual pet. It's not played in this video, and as such I don't show the Carbuncle game either.
